RUBBAN (رُبّان) — Multi-Sport Vizrt Commander (Portable x64)
============================================================
Target OS : Windows 7 / 10 / 11 (x64) — Office-Free (.NET Framework 4.8)
Workspace : D:\rubban\dist\Rubban_Portable

1. STARTUP
   - Run RubbanLauncher.exe (single-instance protected).
   - Splash screen displays Rubban/SBA branding and probes local Vizrt ports.
   - Workstation selector waits 3 seconds (pauses if dropdown is opened).

2. TRANSPORTS & SPORTS
   - Basketball : Viz Engine mode (6100/6800), +1/+2/+3 and -1/-2/-3 buttons.
   - Handball   : Viz Engine mode (6100/6800), large +1/-1 buttons.
   - Futsal     : Viz Engine mode (6100/6800), large +1/-1 buttons + Penalty Shootout panel.
   - Football   : Auto-switches to Viz Trio socket mode (Port 6200, \r\n) + Cards, Subs, ET & Penalty panels.

3. TEAMS, ROSTER & DATA (OFFICE-FREE)
   - Click "الفرق واللاعبين / TEAMS & ROSTER" to create, edit, save teams,
     open existing .json or .xlsx files, or generate a blank Rubban_Team_Template.xlsx.
   - Click "بيانات المباراة / DATA ENTRY" to set Tournament, Place, Referees, Logos & Colors.

4. CUSTOMIZING TEMPLATES
   - Edit JSON files inside Templates\ (viz_*.json and trio_*.json) without recompiling.
